abstract: We prove a conjecture of K\"uhnel, Lassmann, and Lutz, first asked in 1984, that the minimal number of vertices in a triangulation of the $3$-dimensional torus is $15$.
hook: Any triangulation of the 3-dimensional torus needs at least 15 vertices, settling a 1984 conjecture.
summary: The authors prove the Kuhnel-Lassmann-Lutz conjecture: the fewest vertices in a triangulation of the 3-torus is 15. The abstract gives no method details. It settles the minimum for this one manifold and says nothing about other 3-manifolds.
title: The minimum size of the 3-dimensional torus
